title: Traffic Markings - New
description: Use this service request for concerns related to new traffic markings. Including: lane line striping, edge lines, crosswalks, stop legends, etc. This can also be used to remove existing markings. A name, address, and daytime phone are required for this request. ** For highways or freeways please contact Texas Department of Transportation (TXDOT). ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 10 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for new or removed traffic markings on a Dallas city street.
actions.why: For new traffic markings such as lane lines, edge lines, crosswalks, stop legends, or for removing existing markings on a Dallas city roadway. The 311 request form asks whether markings are needed because of a current or recent construction project; if not, it asks the marking type. A name, address, and daytime phone are required.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Traffic Markings - New" requests does not apply to highways, freeways, or parking lots. If markings are missing because of a current or recent City construction project, then consider the "Paving Reconstruction Project" 311 request identified by the Dallas 311 website. If the marking is for a highway or freeway, then contact TxDOT at 800-558-9368.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Markings - New"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Markings - New"

actions.tagline: Contact TxDOT about highway or freeway traffic markings.
actions.why: For new or removed traffic markings on a highway or freeway. The 311 request form directs this selection to TxDOT at the number shown in its instruction.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about missing markings caused by a construction project.
actions.why: For markings missing because of a current or recent construction project when the concern involves a City reconstruction project. People who answer Yes to the construction-project question see a Paving Reconstruction Project instruction. The public "Paving Reconstruction Project" service has an online request form for City reconstruction projects.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Paving Reconstruction Project" requests applies to reconstruction work performed by the City or complaints about a City reconstruction project; it does not apply to non-City reconstruction work.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Paving Reconstruction Project"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Paving Reconstruction Project"
